dsh-quick-explain

`dsh-quick-explain` is a DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: highlight a word or a sentence in any messag
e, click **💡 Explain**, and a temporary side conversation opens on the right. It explains the fragme
nt, answers follow-ups, and disappears when you close it — the main chat keeps its exact history and

中文说明
## Why
Sometimes you need to understand one word, one acronym, or one sentence in the middle of a long task
. Asking the main assistant means adding a turn you will have to live with: it enters the session lo
g, the model's context, and every later request. This plugin gives you a separate, disposable explai
's context, and every later request. This plugin gives you a separate, disposable explainer instead.
## Features
- **Selection → aside.** Highlight 1–1200 characters in the transcript; a small chip appears next to

the selection.
- **Explains in place.** The side panel streams a short explanation of the selected

text, using the paragraph around it as context.
- **Follow-up questions.** Keep digging in the panel

; each question stays in the side conversation.
- **Zero impact on the main session.** Nothing is ap
pended to the session log, no message is added to the conversation, and the main model request is un

touched.
- **Uses your own model.** The side calls go through DSH's own `ctx.llm.stream` with your c

onfigured default model.
- **Native chrome.** The panel is a right-edge sheet built from DSH's own t
heme tokens — same hairlines, radii, type scale and motion — so it reads as part of the app instead

of a third-party card.
- **Disposable by design.** Closing the panel, or 30 minutes of inactivity, d

rops the side conversation from host memory.
- **Local only.** The panel talks to a route inside you
r running DSH process; no extra service, no telemetry.
## Install
In DSH Desktop: open the **Plugins** page (sidebar, or Settings → Plugins) → **Add plugin**:

1. In **Package name or address**, enter `dsh-quick-explain`.
2. Select **Install**, then **Enable n
ow**. If DSH says the change takes effect at the next start, quit DSH completely and open it again.
If npm is not reachable, you can instead enter the full path of a `.tgz` (`npm pack dsh-quick-explai
n`), or `github:JujiuYey/dsh-quick-explain`.

tep; the Client half (`client.js`) is a plain script that registers a lazy factory with `window.__Mo
t half (`client.js`) is a plain script that registers a lazy factory with `window.__ModuleLoader__`.
Requirements: DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` or a compatible release that provides `ctx.connection.fetch`, `ctx.ll
m`, `ctx.agentDefaultModel`, and the `shell.overlay` client slot.
## Privacy
The selected text, the paragraph around it, and your follow-up questions are sent to the model provi
der configured in DSH — the same provider your main conversation already uses. The side conversation
itself lives only in the Host process memory: it is not written to the session log, not stored on d
isk, and gone after a restart.
## Limitations
- The explainer sees the selection plus its surrounding paragraph, not the full conversation history

— that is the price of leaving the main session untouched.
- Answers render light inline Markdown (

`**bold**` and `` `code` ``); headings and lists are not interpreted.
- Side conversations are per-p

rocess; restarting DSH clears them.
- UI strings are English and Chinese only.
